build_coreml_model: build a CoreML model from a TorchScript module using preprocess with tensor specs and compile spec
create_tensor_spec: create a tensor spec tuple with a shape and scalar dtype for CoreML input or output definition
create_compile_spec: create a compile spec tuple with input specs, output specs, backend, quantization mode, and export path
test_coreml_quantization: test CoreML model quantization with linear or linear_symmetric 8-bit weight quantization
review_preprocess_function: review the preprocess function that converts a TorchScript module to a serialized CoreML model
